assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptoms of palpitations and dizziness in the context of the documented diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
